title: Big Ambitions Companion (Live HQ)
description: Live real-time telemetry streaming companion mod for Big Ambitions. Powers the web-based CFO Profit & Loss dashboard, Storefronts directory, 24h Employee Schedule matrix, Logistics radar, and Real Estate wealth suite on your secondary monitor or mobile browser.
changeLog: v2.5.0: Richer factory and warehouse telemetry (workstations, pallet storage, exports), investment history and risk, real-estate market values, HR and insurance details, a headquarters stream, and a corrected business expense history.
